onset.Description: Seconds from the start of the recording. TDT epoc rows: TDT epoc time. Task rows (GoStimulus, StopStimulus, Response; added in fix-20261030): sample / sampling frequency.

trial_type.Description: TDT epoc store name (e.g. Tic2/Epoc = TDT tick markers, LATT/RATT = attenuation stores), or a task event rebuilt with the authors' ImportRawData.m procedure (code/fix-20261030_stopsignal_events.py): GoStimulus (TTL trigger of the go signal), StopStimulus (go trigger + stop-signal delay of the trial's side), Response (go trigger + RT). Task rows: GoStimulus = go stimulus onset (TTL up-flank on Inpt_RZ2_chn001, last high sample minus 3, as in the authors' code); StopStimulus = stop signal: go trigger + SSD (left or right per trial side); the TTL of the stop trigger itself is in stop_trigger_sample; Response = button press: go trigger + round(RT ms) x sampling frequency / 1000 (go triggers with RT > 0, including failed stops).

value.Description: Epoc value (TDT epoc rows); n/a for task rows

trial.Description: trial number in the behaviour file (trialseq column 1)

stop_trial.Description: 1 if the trial had a stop signal, else 0 (trialseq column 4)

ssd.Description: stop-signal delay of the trial's side, negative values set to 0 as in the authors' code (trialseq column 5 or 6)

stop_trigger_sample.Description: sample of the stop TTL trigger itself (StopStimulus rows; the authors place the stop event at go + SSD instead because the trigger was not sent at the SSD)
